baseline_models.focus_anchor: The definite oath noun at 52:1, rooted in ط و ر and realized as al-tur.
baseline_models.mechanism: The concrete Mount or mountain is recruited as a witness. Its elevation, visibility, and ordinary topographic stability give the otherwise unexpanded oath a fixed external guarantor.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies the concrete Mount or mountain referent and lets the oath draw force from a fixed elevated landmark.

changed_reading.before: A bare oath by a named mountain.
changed_reading.after: A definite elevated landmark stands as a stable, publicly available witness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same focus noun permits the ط و ر images of an extended edge and nearness to a protected surrounding space.
baseline_models.mechanism: Instead of reducing the focus to a summit, this model treats it as a spatial complex: a continuous perimeter plus the approach-zone beside it. The oath marks both an edge and the act of nearing what the edge guards.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies a frontage or perimeter extending alongside a thing and makes the focus an organizing edge.
The branch supplies nearness to a surrounding precinct and turns the edge into an approached threshold.

changed_reading.before: The oath points only upward to a peak.
changed_reading.after: The oath also spreads laterally around a precinct, emphasizing its boundary and approach.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus root carries a branch in which tur is a limit at which one stops or which one exceeds.
baseline_models.mechanism: The oath can install a threshold before any consequence is named. A limit is meaningful because conduct can halt at it, reach its extreme, or pass beyond it.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies a stopping or transgressed limit and makes the sworn object a consequential threshold.

changed_reading.after: The focus names the logic of a boundary: stopping, reaching an extreme, or crossing it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The consonantal focus root also carries the branch of repeated turns, stages, and changing states.
baseline_models.mechanism: A static-looking proper noun can faintly activate temporal succession. The sworn tur may therefore hold a latent contrast between a fixed landmark and things passing through stage after stage.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies successive turns and states and opens a temporal reading inside the spatial noun.

changed_reading.before: Al-tur is wholly static and spatial.
changed_reading.after: Al-tur can also sound a latent note of staged transformation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Two remote ط و ر branches place the focus beyond familiar company and, idiomatically, in a place with no one present.
baseline_models.mechanism: The Mount can be heard as the margin of domesticated human space: unmastered, socially distant, even emptied of ordinary occupants. This coexists with, rather than replaces, the concrete mountain reading.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies wildness outside familiar human company and makes the Mount a margin of domesticated space.
The narrow idiomatic branch supplies a place with no one present and intensifies the focus as an emptied witness-space.

changed_reading.before: The mountain is merely remote terrain.
changed_reading.after: The mountain marks the human margin where familiarity and occupancy fall away.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus perimeter and approach-zone lead a chain of aligned writing, an opened substrate, an inhabited enclosure, an overhead boundary, and gathered or filled water. The sequence makes al-tur the first edge in a nested grammar of display, habitation, covering, and containment.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch supplies the continuous perimeter that organizes the later surfaces and enclosures.
The focus branch supplies approach to a surrounding precinct and gives the enclosure sequence a threshold.
The branch supplies an aligned written row and converts lateral extension into an ordered line.
The branch supplies opening and spreading, making the written line occupy an exposed surface.
The branch supplies shelter and dwelling, changing a mere boundary into a habitable inside.
The branch supplies a community that inhabits a place and fills the bounded interior socially.
The branch supplies a high roof and adds an upper limit to the inhabited enclosure.
The branch supplies land that gathers water and extends containment from building to basin.
The branch supplies filling with water and makes the final vast enclosure materially charged.

structural_cues: 52:1-6 is a waw-linked nominal oath sequence, and 52:3 places the written object inside a spread substrate.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies edge, line, opening, dwelling, roof, gathered-water, and filling images; I supply the arrow that treats them as one expanding containment grammar with the Mount as its first threshold. A live alternative is a heterogeneous list of independent witnesses.

changed_reading.before: The focus is an isolated mountain precinct.
changed_reading.after: The focus inaugurates nested material boundaries, from perimeter to page, house, roof, and sea-basin.

context_deltas.mechanism: The concrete Mount first supplies a benchmark of stability, but the sky then oscillates, the solid mountain class is displaced, and sky matter later descends. The oath gains force not only from permanence but from naming the very stability whose reversal will measure the promised event.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch supplies the Mount as the stable elevated landmark against which later displacement is legible.
The branch supplies repeated oscillation and turns the upper frame from fixed to unstable.
The branch supplies the over-arching sky whose motion destabilizes the Mount's spatial frame.
The branch supplies removal and displacement, reversing the expected fixity of mountains.
The branch supplies elevated solid mass, making its displacement a direct class-level reversal of the focus.
The branch supplies downward falling and completes the reversal from elevated stability to descent.

structural_cues: 52:9-10 repeats motion with cognate verb and verbal-noun forms, while 52:44 returns to sky matter descending.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a fixed mountain referent followed by intensified sky and mountain motion; I supply the retrospective arrow by which later unmaking changes why the opening landmark is sworn. The live alternative is that the motions describe the event without altering the oath's initial force.

changed_reading.before: The Mount guarantees by being immovable.
changed_reading.after: The Mount guarantees by being the paradigm of stability that the promised event can overturn.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus limit becomes asymmetric. Human beings cross outward in transgression, but the consequence falls and settles, cannot be pushed away, drives them onward, and is finally encountered. The boundary is therefore not an escape ridge but the point where self-directed crossing becomes compelled arrival.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch supplies the limit that may be stopped at or exceeded and grounds the one-way threshold model.
The branch supplies falling followed by fixity, making the consequence arrive and hold its place.
The branch supplies removal of harm, whose explicit absence closes the possibility of pushing the event back.
The branch supplies forceful propulsion and reverses the agents from voluntary movers into the moved.
The branch explicitly supplies exceeding a limit in rebellion and identifies the outward crossing.
The branch supplies what a person encounters, turning the deferred day into an unavoidable meeting.
The branch supplies nearness short of the ultimate end and adds a nearer threshold before the final one.

structural_cues: The consequence sequence moves from occurrence and no repeller to forced propulsion, then names the opponents as transgressors and says they will meet their day.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exceeded limit, landing, blocked repulsion, forced motion, encounter, and a nearer stage; I supply the directional arrow that reads them as one asymmetric boundary system. A live alternative is that these are separate juridical and kinetic metaphors.

changed_reading.before: The Mount marks a limit one may respect or cross.
changed_reading.after: The Mount marks a one-way threshold: transgression crosses outward, but consequence closes inward and must be met.

context_deltas.mechanism: The perimeter and limit branches become epistemic. An authoritative inscription and aligned line appear immediately after the focus; later questions challenge would-be controllers to produce compelling disclosure and expose the claim to possess and write the unseen. Al-tur becomes the threshold between witnessed or warranted inscription and self-authorized speculation.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch supplies an extended edge and lets the Mount function as the margin of an evidentiary field.
The focus branch supplies the consequential limit separating warranted testimony from claims beyond it.
The branch supplies an inscription that establishes a binding judgment or determination and gives the opening text authority.
The branch supplies the aligned written line and materializes the authorized side of the boundary.
The branch supplies controlling surveillance and turns the repeated root into a challenge about who may govern the field.
The branch supplies compelling proof and states the evidentiary demand placed on rival claims.
The branch supplies disclosure by speech or sign and specifies that the demanded proof must reveal its meaning.
The branch supplies what is hidden from sight and locates the far side of the epistemic boundary.
The branch supplies composing letters and names the opponents' challenged act of writing beyond warranted access.

structural_cues: The opening written object is answered later by an extended series of questions about control, access, proof, the unseen, and writing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated writing and line roots plus explicit challenges about control, proof, disclosure, and hidden knowledge; I supply the jurisdictional arrow tying those tests back to the focus limit. A live alternative is rhetorical recurrence without a Mount-centered epistemic structure.

changed_reading.before: The Mount is one physical witness among others.
changed_reading.after: The Mount is also the margin of authorized testimony, beyond which claims of control and unseen writing must produce proof.

context_deltas.mechanism: The initially wild or empty precinct is progressively filled and ordered: a community inhabits, couches align, descendants catch up, attendants circulate, valued persons are protected, and family space is remembered as familiar habitation. The focus becomes a threshold between estrangement and restored social order, not merely an unpeopled height.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch supplies the approached precinct in which later social ordering can occur.
The focus branch supplies distance from familiar company and establishes the social condition later reversed.
The focus branch supplies an empty place and gives repopulation a sharp starting contrast.
The branch supplies the community inhabiting a place and begins the reversal of vacancy.
The branch supplies alignment on a level line and makes the restored social interior ordered rather than crowded.
The branch supplies a later party catching and reaching those ahead and makes family restoration kinetic.
The branch supplies circulation around a center and turns the precinct into an actively serviced social orbit.
The branch supplies protective concealment and makes the interior preserve rather than merely contain its occupants.
The branch supplies the familiarity of an inhabited place and closes the movement from wild margin to human belonging.

structural_cues: The reward scene repeatedly uses spatially ordered social acts: reclining in rows, joining descendants, circulation, face-to-face questioning, and recollection of family life.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies habitation, alignment, catching-up, circulation, protection, and domestic familiarity; I supply the arrow that reads them as repopulating the focus precinct and repairing its wild or empty branch. A live alternative is a reward list with no retrospective spatial effect on al-tur.

changed_reading.before: The Mount is an empty margin outside human company.
changed_reading.after: The Mount is a threshold across which vacancy is reversed into protected, aligned, circulating community.

context_deltas.mechanism: The remote stages branch receives an extended temporal mechanism: oscillation and return, a later growth catching the first, a specified time of rising, and the passage from night to the retreat of rising stars. The static Mount and the successive tur can therefore coexist as spatial landmark and temporal turn.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch supplies successive turns and stages and provides the temporal anchor for the cycle model.
The branch supplies rotation and return and gives the cosmic change a recurring rather than merely linear motion.
The branch supplies later growth following the first and maps generational joining onto succession of stages.
The branch supplies the proper time of an act and articulates a marked temporal station.
The branch supplies bodily rising and makes the marked time begin with a transition of posture.
The branch supplies the end and passing consequence of a thing and marks one phase withdrawing.
The branch supplies a rising star whose later retreat makes the cycle visible in the sky.

structural_cues: The context repeatedly marks a day, former and later states, generational joining, rising, night, and the retreat of stars.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies turn, succession, appointed time, rising, ending, and star-cycle images; I supply the arrow that reads them through the focus root's stages branch. The live alternative, favored by the surface noun, is that al-tur remains only the Mount and the temporal echoes are accidental.

changed_reading.before: Al-tur is a spatial object untouched by the context's time sequence.
changed_reading.after: Al-tur also cues the measured passage of beings and cosmic signs through successive states.

context_deltas.mechanism: Wildness becomes relational rather than zoological or merely geographic. Domestic familiarity supplies the inside, transgression crosses its proper limit, and abandonment leaves the transgressors outside. The Mount's wild margin can thus model estrangement from an inhabited moral and social order.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch supplies departure from familiar company and anchors wildness as an outside condition.
The branch supplies inhabited familiarity and defines the social inside from which estrangement is measured.
The branch supplies rebellious excess beyond a limit and provides the motion from inside to outside.
The branch supplies leaving or abandoning and stabilizes the transgressors' condition as social estrangement.

structural_cues: 52:26 locates prior fear among family, 52:32 names a transgressing people, and 52:45 commands that they be left until their encounter.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies domestic belonging, limit-crossing, and abandonment; I supply the social arrow that interprets the focus's wildness as de-familiarization produced by conduct. A live alternative is that the three contexts have no shared social topology.

changed_reading.before: The Mount is physically wild because it lies away from settlement.
changed_reading.after: The Mount's wildness figures the relational state of having crossed beyond familiar and protected order.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps terrain onto writing material rather than taking al-tur only as a mountain. It remains anchored in the focus's extended-perimeter branch and in the immediate aligned-line, thin-earth, and spread-surface branches. Downstream prose should call it a material analogy, not a lexical translation of al-tur as page or script.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus perimeter can behave like the margin or raised stroke of a surface.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch supplies a long edge alongside a thing and permits a topographic margin image.
The branch supplies the aligned written row and turns the edge into a legible stroke.
The branch supplies thin soft earth and materially bridges writing substrate and landscape.
The branch supplies opening and spreading and lets the landscape be imagined as an unfolded field.

changed_reading.before: The Mount and the written sheet are adjacent but unrelated oath objects.
changed_reading.after: The Mount can be carried as a raised margin or stroke in a landscape imagined as an opened manuscript.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because its trigger is the non-dominant mapped root for و ق ع and contributes a level spread rather than the ordinary falling sense. It remains anchored in the focus's mountain branch and is reinforced by the explicit displacement of solid mountains. Downstream prose should preserve it only as a split-root topographic experiment, not as the primary sense of 52:7.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The concrete elevated Mount supplies one pole of a height-to-level topographic reversal.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch supplies the elevated Mount whose topography is available for inversion.
The non-dominant mapped branch supplies spreading in a level place and activates the opposed planar endpoint.
The branch supplies elevated solid mass and confirms that the focus belongs to the class being transformed.
The branch supplies removal and makes the movement from elevated mass toward cleared level space mechanically possible.

changed_reading.before: The Mount is the surah's fixed vertical landmark.
changed_reading.after: The Mount also carries the exploratory image of elevation destined to be removed into level spread.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins a narrow focus idiom to a remote branch of a split context root whose surface action is forceful propulsion. It remains anchored in the focus branch of nobody being present and gains structural support from abandonment and night. Downstream prose should mark it as a branch-distant vacancy motif and must not replace the direct meanings of the cited context forms.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The narrow ط و ر idiom permits the sworn place to be heard as having no ordinary person present.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch supplies the idiom of nobody being in a place and establishes the vacancy motif.
The non-dominant mapped branch supplies a house empty of any caller and sharpens vacancy through absence of voluntary summons.
The branch supplies leaving or abandonment and extends the empty-place image into the opponents' deferred condition.
The branch supplies night and darkness and gives the emptied witness-space a final temporal setting.

changed_reading.before: The Mount is remote but ordinarily inhabited or visited.
changed_reading.after: The Mount can flicker as an emptied calling-place where ordinary presence recedes before compelled encounter and nocturnal witness.

strongest_changes: The opening oath chain turns the Mount's perimeter into a nested system of line, spread surface, habitation, roof, and basin.
The moving sky and mountains revise the Mount from a guarantee by permanence into the stability whose unmaking measures the promised event.
Repeated writing, control, proof, and unseen-knowledge cues make the focus limit an epistemic boundary.
Ordered habitation, joining, and circulation repopulate the focus precinct while an estrangement reading remains live.
summary.what_was_special: A one-word focus exposed unusually divergent but mutually activatable branches: concrete mountain, perimeter, precinct, limit, successive stage, wildness, and vacancy. The context repeatedly supplied exact mechanisms for several of them, so no single final reading absorbs the others.
remaining_uncertainties: The definite surface most directly supports the concrete Mount; stage, wildness, and vacancy remain branch-distant.
The enclosure and manuscript models depend on reader-supplied coherence across a sequence that may instead list independent witnesses.
The height-to-level and empty-caller outliers depend on non-dominant split-root branches and require explicit exploratory containment.
